<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative Agenda:</strong> The Lok Sabha has initiated a 10-hour debate on the Anti-Paper Leak Bill, which proposes stricter punishments to curb examination irregularities, alongside discussions on a Bill concerning Supreme Court judges.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNQW1uV2lLV0pVVGFac0psVVdBeVl3ZE04MnR1VUMyVzFKNmdvWm55ZEhvWXR3LWVRYUp5Q3N0ZmF4ZFNBRGtmVVBra1M3N2xyTC1RYWgtUGVqQkptbXVxWUJYX3RUY25NV0taU1NfRUFPcmlJUm43cUEtY1VIdm1tc2RXZFVJYlJNRWFQVEhka19BTUE0UVJ5bw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Disruptions:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament faced repeated adjournments as the INDIA bloc protested alleged police brutality against NEET demonstrators, with the Supreme Court also reviewing petitions regarding the use of force against protesters.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political Tensions:</strong> Tensions flared in Parliament as NDA MPs gave a &quot;hero&#x27;s welcome&quot; to former Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, prompting sharp criticism from the Congress party, which labeled the gesture an insult to the nation&#x27;s youth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial Review:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued notice on a plea filed by Union Minister Suresh Gopi challenging a Kerala High Court verdict regarding his election victory in Thrissur.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Examination Reform:</strong> The government has signaled its intent to pass the Anti-Paper Leak Bill regardless of Opposition participation, emphasizing the necessity of the legislation to restore integrity to national examination processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPQk9QTUNLSTIyc0ROOWxROTBDSDhhU1B4b2YxclFQTDhrREw4SU5WRGFXMVA3MVFJOTB4cTh6MkV5WTB2U2dtVVlPUDY4MVJ6ZTR6aHBMX0poTl9maVo2MFlBOURzLXI2U2IxbGNzR3IybFU4OTBYLWtPTlg3YzVaVVlqcjFEazQ2Sy1xR2t3SF9kR3FHRjNJcTlVYnBLMUlVdlNuTVQ3RTNBelZQVWF0MTVadXlfSHpNTklyd3JB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
</ul>
